name: contract-model-identity
goal: Require the requested exact worker model to be reported; preserve usage and leave unidentified executions failed without fallback

evidence: Codex task completions with no reported model are accepted by ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.codex. Existing live Luna records therefore cannot prove execution identity. Preserve those original outcomes and close admission for future unidentified completions.

The existing model-mismatch case exercises only a different Claude model. Strengthen that unchanged case with absent and different Codex and Claude model reports, retaining original mismatch coverage and captured usage; add no test declarations.
